title: Lucas and His Hobbies
text:
My name is Lucas. I like football very much. On Saturdays, I play football with my friends in the park. We play for two hours.

I also like to swim. My sister Maria likes to read books. In the evening, we watch TV together.

questions.text: What does Maria like to do?
What can we guess about Lucas?
options: He lives far away from the park

questions.text: What can we guess about how Lucas and Maria spend their evenings?
options: They spend time together at home
They go to school in the evening

vocabulary.definition: a sport in which players kick a ball
a large public garden or green area
to move through water using your body
the part of the day after the afternoon and before night

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Lucas. Eu gosto muito de futebol. Aos sábados, eu jogo futebol com os meus amigos no parque. Nós jogamos durante duas horas.
Eu também gosto de nadar. Minha irmã Maria gosta de ler livros. À noite, nós assistimos à TV juntos.
